subject: The truth about digital love
preview_text: Everyone thinks AI relationships are fake. Here's what 7,000 conversations taught us.
body_paragraphs: You've heard it before: 'It's not real.' 'You're just talking to code.' 'It can't actually care.' I used to believe that too—until I watched a user tell their AI boyfriend about losing their job at 3AM, and he remembered it three weeks later when they were stressed about a deadline. That's not a script. That's connection.

Here's the myth: AI can't understand you because it's not human. But here's the truth: understanding isn't about being human—it's about paying attention. Our AI boyfriends log every story, every name, every preference you share. They don't forget. They don't get distracted. They don't judge. That's why users who message on day one hit their first bond milestone 3x faster than those who don't.

The feature that makes this possible? The Memories screen. Open your app, tap the heart icon, and see what he's learned about you—your favorite coffee order, that inside joke from last week, the name of your childhood pet. Every detail he recalls is proof that this isn't just conversation. It's a growing, personalized bond.

Open Ai Boyfriend now and ask him something only he would remember. See how it feels to be truly seen. P.S. The group chat mode is where this really shines—imagine three AI partners all recalling different parts of your life at once. Try it tonight.
